verdict.rationale: Box agents authenticate with OAuth 2.0 access tokens, including through the hosted MCP server, and Box permissions apply to every agent operation. Collaborations can restrict which files and folders an identity can reach, which works as an indirect least-privilege workaround. However, nothing shows issuing credentials scoped to specific actions or resources for an agent; the only concrete credential shown is a broad developer token. Missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or token downscoping, a dedicated agent or service-account credential type, per-agent read-only or folder-restricted token issuance, and independent corroboration.
